prompt: Feed the penguins: bring a fish to each of the four penguins

intent.setting: A frozen arctic island with four ice floes and rock outcrops, a central beach, and a shallow pond where fish can be caught.
intent.role: Player is a penguin caretaker carrying a small sled for fish.
intent.goal: Catch or collect a fish and deliver one to each of the four penguins standing on separate floes before they wander off.
intent.fail: A penguin loses patience and walks away before being fed.
intent.headline: Four penguins each need a fish delivered from the pond
